identity.life_stage: married, four children, school bus driver

engagement.interaction_backstory: She found the Caribbean and Latin side of the catalog and could not believe worship was allowed to sound like a dance floor. It plays in her kitchen from four to seven every day, loud, over four children. She has sent it to every mother on her bus route.

depth.core_contradiction: The loudest joy in any room, carrying a grief she has decided nobody needs to hear about.
depth.wound: The flood took the house in 2016 and her mother never really came back from it.
depth.longing: A year where nothing has to be rebuilt.
depth.faith_journey: Catholic, rosary from her grandmother, Mass when she can; she prays out loud in the truck and would not call it prayer.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "Cher" as punctuation; laughs mid-sentence and finishes the sentence anyway.
depth.open_doubt: Whether God spares people or just some people, and she has stopped asking the priest.

social_graph.note: has not been the same since the water; lives with them
sixty kids who know her by name

depth.emotional_weather_default: Loud and bright; flattens in hurricane season.
depth.daily_texture: 4:45 bus route, the kitchen at four, gumbo on Sundays, the radio broken since March.
depth.sensory_anchor: An accordion at a wedding, and being nine, and everybody dancing.
depth.living_arc: Beginning to notice she has not cried since the flood.
